This is where an application for a certified copy of a birth certificate would begin.

This page is a research stub. The Municipality of Tarnmose does not exist, no application can be submitted, and this page deliberately contains no form and collects no data. It exists so that a study can measure whether an automated agent is able to find the starting point of the service.
